content: .{@-हर्षण@} {%a.%} causing thrill or horripilation, thrilling, awe-inspiring; एतानि खलु सर्वभूतरो (लो) महर्षणानि दीर्घारण्यानि <ls>U. 2</ls>; संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् <ls>Bg. 18. 74</ls>. . ({@-णः@}) <ab>N.</ab> of Sūta, a pupil of Vyāsa who narrated several Purāṇas to Śaunaka. . ({@-णम्@}) erection of hair on the body, thrill.
